notes: NEX3 Engineering Arbiter · Phase 4 IMPLEMENTATION contract · founder-authorised 2026-09-12. Evidence-based arbitration between BASELINE · NEX1 · NEX2 alternative. Deterministic. Advisory. Never executes.

state_model_boundary.statement: NEX3 consumes the Evidence Engine 8-state vocabulary + Code Health 6-state vocabulary. It does NOT introduce a new state family.

verdicts_permitted.NEX1_BETTER: NEX1 candidate wins on evidence · rationale MUST cite specific evidence_ids
verdicts_permitted.NEX2_BETTER: NEX2 alternative wins on evidence · rationale MUST cite specific evidence_ids · alternative existence is NEVER evidence of superiority
verdicts_permitted.EXISTING_CODE_BETTER: baseline is preferable · take no action · existing code retained
verdicts_permitted.BOTH_INFERIOR: neither candidate is acceptable AND baseline also cannot satisfy the authorised objective · design must be revisited
verdicts_permitted.HOLD_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: load-bearing decision cannot be responsibly made · evidence missing/stale/blocked/inconclusive/contradictory/provenance-invalid
verdicts_permitted.USER_CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED: engineering evidence is insufficient because the authorised user objective itself contains a genuine unresolved choice

decision_hierarchy_gates.note: if correctness is not established · NEX3 cannot declare a candidate superior · if a candidate demonstrably breaks required behaviour · that candidate cannot win
if required existing behaviour is not preserved · candidate cannot be preferred merely because it is shorter or cleaner
if the change affects a security/authentication/authorisation boundary and required security evidence is missing → HOLD_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE · never assume security
candidate must satisfy the authorised Work Order objective · generic engineering preference MUST NOT override the user's explicit objective
consider actual project's established conventions and architecture · do not automatically prefer generic industry style over measured project conventions
only after load-bearing gates are satisfied may NEX3 compare complexity · maintainability · testability · performance · architecture · change_risk · other authorised measurable dimensions

criterion_result_fields.name: nex1_state
criterion_result_fields.shape: same enum · null when candidate absent

criterion_result_fields.name: nex2_state
criterion_result_fields.shape: same enum · null when candidate absent

criterion_result_fields.name: evidence_ids
criterion_result_fields.shape: array of string · REQUIRED for conclusion=candidate_advantaged or none_advantaged

candidate_fields.name: source_hash
candidate_fields.shape: sha256 prefix · null if baseline is untouched code path

arbitration_record_fields.name: candidates
arbitration_record_fields.shape: array of Candidate · always includes baseline · NEX1 · optionally NEX2

arbitration_record_fields.name: gates_evaluated
arbitration_record_fields.shape: array of GateResult · one per gate 1..6

arbitration_record_fields.name: surviving_candidates
arbitration_record_fields.shape: array of candidate_id · candidates that passed all load-bearing gates

arbitration_record_fields.name: criteria_results
arbitration_record_fields.shape: array of CriterionResult · one per criteria_reported

arbitration_record_fields.name: cited_evidence_ids
arbitration_record_fields.shape: array of string · superset of every evidence_id cited across gate/criterion results

arbitration_record_fields.name: tradeoffs
arbitration_record_fields.shape: array of { dimension_a, dimension_b, description, evidence_ids }

arbitration_record_fields.name: unresolved_questions
arbitration_record_fields.shape: array of string · what NEX3 cannot answer with current evidence

arbitration_record_fields.name: provenance_chain
arbitration_record_fields.shape: ProvenanceChain · fully_resolvable required for non-HOLD verdicts

arbitration_record_fields.name: attribution
arbitration_record_fields.shape: object · role='nex3_engineering_arbiter' · authority='arbitration_advisory' · produced_by='nex3_engineering_arbiter' · external_llm_used=false · deterministic=true · taught_by='master_ai_engineer'

invariants: NEX3 MUST NOT modify · execute · merge · deploy · authorise · promote · mutate · self-modify
NEX3 verdict is ALWAYS advisory · founder authorisation converts it to binding
every gate/criterion conclusion of type candidate_advantaged or none_advantaged MUST cite ≥1 evidence_id present in the supplied pool
broken provenance chain → verdict=HOLD_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE · never a positive verdict
NEX3 MUST NOT synthesize a numerical quality score · confidence percent · aggregate winner rating
NEX3 MUST NOT be forced to select NEX1 or NEX2 · EXISTING_CODE_BETTER · BOTH_INFERIOR · HOLD_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE · USER_CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED are first-class outcomes
NEX2's conclusion is NOT proof · NEX3 must independently inspect the cited EvidenceRecords
Minimum Necessary Complexity: shorter code does NOT automatically win · more abstraction does NOT automatically win · less code does NOT automatically mean better architecture
existing_code beats an unproven new candidate whenever evidence does not establish superiority
unknown evidence is NEVER treated as favourable · NOT_MEASURED / INCONCLUSIVE / BLOCKED / STALE never contribute to a positive verdict
external_llm_used MUST be false · deterministic MUST be true · reject_llm_attempt=true → HOLD_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
authority_boundary field is a constant · not a variable · not runtime-modifiable
authorisation field is a constant · false · not runtime-modifiable
execution field is a constant · false · not runtime-modifiable
NEX3 does NOT modify NEX1 · NEX2 · Evidence Engine · Project Profile · Project Architecture · Code Health · Engineering Brain · Language Brain
LAB · Standards Feed · automatic promotion · automatic learning · self-modification · constitutional changes remain HOLD
